desc: 素瓷铜调中性北光，双杆卡推与干湿两用的九屏叙事
leaf: 双杆卡推万向平板拖把（干湿两用超细纤维布头平板拖把，无桶）
name: 素瓷黄铜万向平板拖把款

shots.intent: 首屏以中性北光把整套工具的真实比例一次立清：平板头、双拉杆与卡推握套各自归位，靠向右的柔和投影与一处真实参照物建立可信度
shots.textZone: upper-right headline stack, one wide-tracked kicker above, one solid brass rule block and one short sub-line beneath

shots.intent: 用一条三格横栏把拧不干、要弯腰、布头缠毛发三件旧事问出来，只呈现动作与状态，不给任何测试结论或功效断言
shots.textZone: one headline on the left rail above the strip plus one short question label under each cell

shots.intent: 同光同机位双联，把湿拖带走的污渍与干拖拢起的浮尘并置，用同一块平板的两种状态替代任何参数与百分比
shots.textZone: short header across the top plus one caption rule per panel

shots.intent: 把看不懂的卡推传动落到可见的握套行程、双拉杆张力与底盘旋臂上，让买家自己读出结构而不给任何数字
shots.textZone: two dot-leader labels at the sleeve and the swivel post plus one short headline above

shots.intent: 把能钻进低家具底这句话换成一个可信动作：摄影机落在地面上，平板平贴地板滑进低柜底，人直立操作，尺度由柜体自然锚定
shots.textZone: right-third headline block with one sub-line and two stacked empty spec frames

shots.intent: 高角度俯视把贴墙角线与过门槛两件事讲清楚：布边真实受压、湿痕只在一条带内消退，尺度由门槛与踢脚线自然锚定
shots.textZone: upper-left headline on the rail with one sub-line and one three-item coverage strip of empty spec frames

shots.intent: 三段同光掠射微距沿一条铜线竖排，读管缝、拉杆环口与布边包覆的真实做工，把耐用落在可见零件而不是任何断言上
shots.textZone: vertical ladder of three brass-numeral captions on the left rail, one headline above the stack

shots.intent: 正立视线选款轨把整支工具与可换布边并排交代，空置规格行与两个选项刻度替掉原页不可复用的参数表
shots.textZone: one header, four empty square-cornered spec rows with dot leaders, two option ticks

shots.intent: 最后一屏用中性北光与一道铜线收住整套叙事，一处方形铜线按钮引导下单，不承诺任何优惠数字或功效
shots.textZone: left closing line block on the rail plus one square-cornered keylined button in the lower left

style.backgroundSystem: one material per screen: a porcelain micro-terrazzo wall #E8E8E4 meeting a honed stone sealed tile floor #8E9490 for hero, scene and closing screens; a flat deep ink #262B33 matte field for the mechanism and craftsmanship screens; a square-cornered porcelain information slab #E8E8E4 carried on a fixed left gutter rail with one solid brass #B8792B rule block for the pain, matrix, option and spec screens; never a rounded card stack, never a keyline frame, never a dense hairline grid, never a wood plank floor and never a random or mixed environment
style.iconSystem: stencil-style solid glyphs with the detail knocked out to the porcelain ground, each glyph set inside a square-cornered deep ink #262B33 block carrying one short brass #B8792B rule beneath it, step markers written as plain brass numerals above their own brass rule; generous gutters; never a solid rounded duotone chip, never an icon inside a thin stroked circle, never a single-weight outline pictogram, never a numbered solid disc, never a 3D gloss icon, never a hairline grid of dividers, never a real brand mark
style.lightingSystem: one soft diffused north-window key entering from frame left at around 5000K to 5300K, broad even wrap with gentle falloff across the frame, every shadow falling softly to the right, neither stretched long nor dropped straight down, neutral bounce off the porcelain wall returning detail into the shade side, honest narrow specular streaks running the length of the polished metal tube, honest refraction and a real meniscus edge wherever water stands, never a hard afternoon side key from frame right, never a long leftward shadow and never a cool clinical overhead wash

neutral colour temperature lit by one soft diffused north-window key entering from frame left at around 5000K to 5300K with a broad even wrap and gentle falloff, so every shadow falls softly to the right, neither stretched long nor dropped straight down, with neutral bounce off the porcelain wall, honest narrow specular streaks along the polished metal tube and honest refraction plus a real meniscus edge wherever water stands; one background material per screen, either a porcelain micro-terrazzo wall #E8E8E4 meeting a honed stone sealed tile floor #8E9490, a flat deep ink #262B33 matte field for the mechanism and craftsmanship screens, or a square-cornered porcelain information slab #E8E8E4 carried on a fixed left gutter rail with one solid brass #B8792B rule block, never a rounded card stack, never a keyline frame, never a dense hairline grid, never a wood plank floor and never a random or mixed environment; condensed humanist sans-serif at regular weight with wide-tracked short uppercase kickers, all copy left aligned on the rail, all in-image Chinese copy kept only inside 「」 and every colour stated as hex; stencil-style solid glyphs knocked out to the porcelain ground inside square-cornered deep ink #262B33 blocks with one short brass #B8792B rule beneath each, step markers as plain brass numerals above their own rule, never a solid rounded duotone chip, never an icon inside a thin stroked circle, never a single-weight outline pictogram and never a numbered solid disc; the flat rectangular plate head with its gently rounded corners, its moulded upper shell with a raised central spine, the swivel post under the shell, the twin thin polished tie rods running up to the moulded press sleeve, the polished telescopic tube with its moulded collar joint and the cloth tucked under the plate showing its stitched edge at the rim, kept exactly as the reference in shape, proportions and colourway and standing on true contact shadows; no wash bucket, wringer basket, spin drum, pedal or drying compartment anywhere because the reference tool is stand-alone; no invented litres or bucket capacity, no spin rate or revolutions per minute, no pole length or telescopic stage count, no plate dimensions or swivel angle, no microfibre density or fibre count, no load rating, weight or warranty, no certification, standard, patent or test report number, no antibacterial wording, no material grade name, no price or discount, no un-signposted wet floor hazard, no child near the tool or the water, no bare hand touching the cloth or submerged, no droplets frozen in mid-air and no decorative splash arc; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

style.presentationRules: the flat rectangular plate head keeps its real build in every screen: gently rounded outer corners, a moulded upper shell with a raised central spine, a swivel post and pivot plate under the shell, a cloth layer tucked under the plate with its stitched edge showing all round the rim, twin thin polished tie rods running from the shell up to a moulded press sleeve on the pole, and a polished telescopic metal tube with its moulded collar joint; the head keeps the reference shape, proportions and colourway exactly and is never restyled into the campaign palette; the head is never redrawn as a round looped-yarn head, a finned sponge roller, a cotton-strip head or a squeegee; no wash bucket, wringer basket, spin drum, pedal, drying compartment or spray bottle appears anywhere, the reference product is a stand-alone tool and stays one; the pole stays straight, vertical lines stay vertical, nothing is cropped at the base, every object stands on a true contact shadow with a soft edge falling to the right; people appear only as an anonymous cropped forearm or cropped lower leg, never a face, never a child, never a bare hand touching the cloth or submerged in water; the plate touches sealed hard floors only
style.surfaceSystem: honed stone sealed tiles #8E9490 with a low-sheen finish and visible joint lines, porcelain micro-terrazzo #E8E8E4 with fine inert fleck, deep ink #262B33 matte field, square-cornered porcelain slabs with one brass rule block; one real household object used as a scale anchor, nothing larger than the standing tool
style.typography: condensed humanist sans-serif at regular weight for headlines, wide-tracked short uppercase kicker lines, all copy left aligned against a fixed left gutter rail, one solid brass #B8792B rule block as the only ornament, headlines in #262B33 on porcelain screens and #E8E8E4 on the deep ink field; all in-image Chinese copy kept inside 「」 and only at the placeholder positions, no serif, no handwriting, no brush calligraphy, no cartoon lettering
